gender.title: Tell me a bit about you

spotty.hello: Hi, I'm Spotty, your running buddy. Every finish line starts with one easy step. I'll build a plan that fits your life and run every kilometre of it with you.
spotty.name: First things first. Let's get to know each other.
spotty.nameKnown: {name}. Good name for a finisher. Ready when you are.
spotty.gender: Nice to meet you, {name}. This helps me tune load and recovery.
spotty.goal: Now the big one. Pick a goal, or tell me in your own words, {name}.
spotty.thinking: Hmm, let me think about that…
spotty.goalGot: Got it: {goal}. We'll get there step by step.
spotty.goalUnsure: I didn't quite catch that. Pick the closest goal above?
spotty.body: Just numbers to set your starting weights. No judgement here, only progress.

level.beginner: Everyone starts somewhere. I'll teach every move step by step.
level.intermediate: Solid base. Time to add structure and progress.
level.advanced: A seasoned athlete. I'll keep the challenge real.

spotty.days: {n} days a week, {min} minutes each. Consistency beats intensity, and that's very doable.
spotty.daysMany: {n} days a week. Strong commitment. I'll make sure you still recover.
spotty.fighter: Now the fun part: choose your coach. Your coach sets the tone of every workout.
spotty.fighterPicked: Good pick. {trainer} and I make a strong team.
spotty.sync: Last step. Connect your watch so I can see heart rate and recovery.
spotty.ready: {name}, your plan is ready. Week one starts now. Easy pace, steady progress.
spotty.building: Give me a moment, {name}. I'm building your plan from everything you told me.
